newsitem.title: USA: Speedway says to raise $125 million.
newsitem.headline: Speedway says to raise $125 million.

text.p: Speedway Motorsports said Friday it intends to raise approximately $125 million through a private placement of senior subordinated notes.
Speedway Motorsports said it will use the net proceeds to pay any indebtedness outstanding under its existing bank credit facility.

The placement is subject to market and other conditions. The company said the securities to be offered in the private placement will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or applicable state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold absent registration under the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws or applicable exemptions from registration requirements.
